_comment: Example ~/.pi/agent/models.json adding a LOCAL Gemma provider for pi.
pi speaks OpenAI-compatible provider APIs; point it at any OpenAI-compatible
endpoint (llama.cpp llama-server or vLLM). The 'api' value selects pi's API
endpoint (verified with pi 0.80.x). Field names follow pi's provider schema;
adjust to your installed pi version if needed.
Run pi with:  pi --provider local-gemma --model gemma-3-12b-it
